title: Residual lost-update window: a holder that was legitimately displaced (unverifiable owner stalled >30 s, or any holder stalled >1 h) and stalls after its last pre-rename check still renames over the displacer's acknowledged write
area: packages/core/src/job-queue/queue-store.ts saveQueue (token + content re-check, then rename) and queue-lock.ts judge
evidence: Pinned by test 'RESIDUAL, PINNED (ISS-JOBQSTALL-001)' in file-job-queue.stalled-holder.test.ts: B (wallNow = now + 1 h + 1 s) enqueues exactly at A's tmp->queue rename on the real fs; A ok, B ok, stored [fromA]. Not reachable for a live same-host holder below 1 h (the recorded ISS-JOBQLOST-003 reproduction, +31 s, now gives A ok / B conflict / stored [fromA]).
fix_direction: A rename cannot compare-and-swap. Closing it needs a primitive the queue does not have (e.g. a heartbeat that makes a live holder visible regardless of age, or a revision-checked store); until then keep critical sections short and wire callers to treat conflict as retry.
class: data write, narrowed to stalls >1 h (same host) or >30 s (unverifiable owner) between the last check and the rename; not closed
